code_python3:
class Solution:
    def stoneGameVI(self, aliceValues: List[int], bobValues: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(aliceValues)
        indices = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: aliceValues[i] + bobValues[i], reverse=True)
        alice = sum(aliceValues[indices[i]] for i in range(0, n, 2))
        bob = sum(bobValues[indices[i]] for i in range(1, n, 2))
        if alice > bob: return 1
        elif alice < bob: return -1
        return 0

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maximumUniqueSubarray(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        seen = set()
        left = 0
        cur_sum = 0
        max_sum = 0
        for right in range(len(nums)):
            while nums[right] in seen:
                seen.remove(nums[left])
                cur_sum -= nums[left]
                left += 1
            seen.add(nums[right])
            cur_sum += nums[right]
            max_sum = max(max_sum, cur_sum)
        return max_sum

title: Minimum Adjacent Swaps for K Consecutive Ones
key_insight: 找到1的位置数组，问题转化为选k个1用最少交换使它们连续，等价于中位数贪心
approach: 记录1的位置，转化为选k个位置使它们变为连续段的最小代价，用前缀和+滑动窗口
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minMoves(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        # positions of 1s
        pos = [i for i, x in enumerate(nums) if x == 1]
        # normalize: pos[i] -= i to account for gaps
        m = len(pos)
        arr = [pos[i] - i for i in range(m)]
        # now find min cost to make k elements equal (median trick)
        prefix = [0] * (m + 1)
        for i in range(m):
            prefix[i+1] = prefix[i] + arr[i]
        res = float('inf')
        for i in range(m - k + 1):
            mid = i + k // 2
            # cost of making arr[i..i+k-1] all equal to arr[mid]
            left_cost = arr[mid] * (mid - i) - (prefix[mid] - prefix[i])
            right_cost = (prefix[i+k] - prefix[mid+1]) - arr[mid] * (i + k - 1 - mid)
            res = min(res, left_cost + right_cost)
        return res

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def halvesAreAlike(self, s: str) -> bool:
        vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
        n = len(s)
        a = sum(1 for c in s[:n//2] if c in vowels)
        b = sum(1 for c in s[n//2:] if c in vowels)
        return a == b

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def totalMoney(self, n: int) -> int:
        weeks = n // 7
        days = n % 7
        # each week i (0-indexed) starts with (i+1) and has sum (i+1)+(i+2)+...+(i+7) = 7*i + 28
        total = sum(7 * i + 28 for i in range(weeks))
        # remaining days start with (weeks + 1)
        start = weeks + 1
        total += sum(start + d for d in range(days))
        return total

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def swapNodes(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        # find kth from beginning
        cur = head
        for _ in range(k - 1):
            cur = cur.next
        first = cur
        # find kth from end
        slow = head
        fast = cur
        while fast.next:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next
        second = slow
        # swap values
        first.val, second.val = second.val, first.val
        return head

title: Checking Existence of Edge Length Limited Paths II
key_insight: 在线查询两点间路径最大边权是否小于limit，用Kruskal建最小生成森林+倍增LCA
approach: 构建最小生成树，树上两点路径最大边权用倍增LCA查询
code_python3:
class DistanceLimitedPathsExist:
    def __init__(self, n, edgeList):
        # Build MST using Kruskal
        self.parent = list(range(2 * n))
        self.weight = [0] * (2 * n)
        self.node_count = n
        edgeList.sort(key=lambda e: e[2])
        for u, v, w in edgeList:
            pu, pv = self.find(u), self.find(v)
            if pu != pv:
                # create new virtual node
                new_node = self.node_count
                self.node_count += 1
                if self.node_count > len(self.parent):
                    self.parent.append(new_node)
                    self.weight.append(0)
                self.parent[pu] = new_node
                self.parent[pv] = new_node
                self.weight[new_node] = w
    def find(self, x):
        while self.parent[x] != x:
            self.parent[x] = self.parent[self.parent[x]]
            x = self.parent[x]
        return x
    def query(self, p, q, limit):
        # find LCA in Kruskal tree
        # path from p to root and q to root, first common ancestor with weight < limit
        path_p = []
        x = p
        while x != self.parent[x]:
            path_p.append(x)
            x = self.parent[x]
        path_p.append(x)
        ancestors = set(path_p)
        x = q
        while x not in ancestors:
            x = self.parent[x]
        lca = x
        return self.weight[lca] < limit if lca != self.find(lca) or lca >= len(self.weight) else self.find(p) == self.find(q) and limit > 0

title: Change Minimum Characters to Satisfy One of Three Conditions
key_insight: 枚举26个字母作为分界点，计算使a的所有字符<分界或b的所有字符<分界的最小修改数
approach: 统计a和b的字符频率，枚举分界字符c：条件1让a<c且b>=c，条件2反之，条件3全变同一字符
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minCharacters(self, a: str, b: str) -> int:
        ca = [0] * 26
        cb = [0] * 26
        for c in a: ca[ord(c)-ord('a')] += 1
        for c in b: cb[ord(c)-ord('a')] += 1
        res = len(a) + len(b)
        for i in range(26):
            # condition 3: make all same char i
            res = min(res, len(a) + len(b) - ca[i] - cb[i])
            if i > 0:
                # condition 1: every char in a < every char in b
                # a all < i, b all >= i
                cost1 = sum(ca[j] for j in range(i, 26)) + sum(cb[j] for j in range(i))
                # condition 2: every char in b < every char in a
                cost2 = sum(cb[j] for j in range(i, 26)) + sum(ca[j] for j in range(i))
                res = min(res, cost1, cost2)
        return res

key_insight: 3D角落堆箱子，底层面积决定总容量，找最小底层面积使总容量>=n
approach: 先按完整层累加，然后在最后一层逐个添加底层格子直到容量足够
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minimumBoxes(self, n: int) -> int:
        # complete layers: layer k has k*(k+1)/2 floor tiles, total boxes = sum of 1..k*(k+1)/2
        total = 0
        floor_tiles = 0
        k = 0
        while total + floor_tiles + k + 1 <= n:
            k += 1
            floor_tiles += k
            total += floor_tiles
        # now add extra tiles on floor one by one
        extra = 0
        j = 0
        while total < n:
            j += 1
            total += j
            extra += 1
        return floor_tiles + extra

approach: 找到LCA后计算两个节点到LCA的深度之和
